## Reviewer Checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked issue and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Tests cover success, failure, authorization, and retry behavior where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, tokens, message content, or sensitive diagnostics are exposed.
- [ ] Generated files and public contracts are current.
- [ ] Documentation and rollback instructions are updated when behavior changes.
